My earlier schedule still holds. I re-checked all 16 constraints against it and each one is satisfied. The derivation also forces every named person's slot, so no other schedule works.

The team note's two options both break constraints:
- **Finn in slot 6:** Finn must be exactly two slots after Hana, and Gus is immediately after Hana. That puts Hana at 7 or earlier, but Hana can't be earlier than 7 because of the Ben/Gus spacing. So Finn can't be in slot 6.
- **Dev in slot 2 and Ivo in slot 3:** Dev must be exactly two slots from Ann, and Ann must be at least 3 slots before Ben. With Ben in slot 5, Ann has to be in slot 1, so Dev has to be in slot 3. Dev in slot 2 doesn't work.

The ninth person isn't named in the constraints, so I used "Eve" as a placeholder. If the real name is Elif, that person takes slot 6.
